data.display_address: Lake Shore Tower, JLT Cluster Y, Jumeirah Lake Towers, Dubai
data.long_description:
Experience contemporary living in this modern, fully furnished 2-bedroom apartment located in the sought-after Lake Shore Tower, Jumeirah Lake Towers (JLT). Spanning a generous 1,283 sq. ft., this well-designed home offers comfort, style, and breathtaking full lake views.

The apartment features a bright and spacious living and dining area, tastefully furnished with modern décor and floor-to-ceiling windows that flood the space with natural light. The open-plan kitchen comes fully equipped with high-quality appliances and ample storage, ideal for everyday living and entertaining.

Both bedrooms are well-sized, fitted with built-in wardrobes, and complemented by two modern bathrooms finished to a high standard. Step onto the balcony and enjoy uninterrupted views of the serene lake, creating a perfect setting to unwind.

Property Highlights:

-2 Bedrooms | 3 Bathrooms
-Size: 1,283 sq. ft.
-Fully furnished, modern interiors
-Full lake view
-Spacious balcony
-Open-plan kitchen with appliances
-Built-in wardrobes
-Covered parking

Building & Location:

Lake Shore Tower, JLT

-Close to Metro station
-Easy access to Sheikh Zayed Road
-Surrounded by cafes, restaurants, and retail outlets
-Well-maintained building with 24/7 security

Building Amenities:

-Gymnasium
-Swimming Pool
-Kids Play Area
-Fitness Area
-Jacuzzi
-BBQ Area

Ideal for end-users and investors alike, this apartment offers a perfect blend of luxury, location, and lifestyle in one of Dubai’s most vibrant communities.
